title: The Bitcoin Contest
style: 1990s American multi-camera television sitcom. 4:3 composition, warm flat studio lighting, slightly soft broadcast-video appearance. Static or gently reframed camera; natural acting and deadpan comedy. Everyone treats their statements as serious. Maintain faces, clothes, voice identities and set geometry across shots. Only Kramer grooming and demeanor change at his return. No captions, graphics, dramatic lighting, extra characters, or cinematic camera movement.
set: Jerry's Manhattan apartment. Reuse its established layout: front door, kitchen counter and living-room window. The characters watch the opposite building through the window; the bitcoiner is off-screen in this draft. Do not invent an insert of him.

characters.Jerry: S1. Jerry Seinfeld: slim, short dark curly hair, blue casual button-down shirt and jeans. Clear, lightly nasal conversational voice, dry delivery.
characters.George: S2. George Costanza: stocky, balding with dark side hair, round glasses, brown plaid shirt and khaki trousers. Mid-pitched nasal voice that tightens when agitated.
characters.Kramer: S3. Cosmo Kramer: tall, lanky, high dark hair, cream patterned short-sleeve shirt and dark trousers. Low, slightly gravelly voice. Same face and clothes throughout; posture and grooming change as specified.
characters.Elaine: S4. Elaine Benes: shoulder-length dark curly hair, burgundy blouse and dark skirt. Clear expressive mid-pitched voice, clipped skeptical delivery.
